verdict.rationale: Godot supports scripted bulk operations via EditorScript (_run() for custom in-editor automation), CLI/headless mode for automation, and explicit bulk import parameter editing across multiple assets at once, giving AI-native users pathways to script batch tasks. However, there's no dedicated bulk-operations API or documentation beyond asset import, and no evidence of headless/CLI batch scripting for general project-wide operations being showcased or validated by users. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk-edit tooling/documentation beyond asset import, independent/community confirmation of scripted bulk workflows, and evidence of scale (many items at once) beyond import parameters.
